verdict.rationale: Cooley has a dedicated patent counseling and prosecution practice page. It describes a global patent team of 100+ lawyers and professionals, many with PhDs and engineering degrees, serving as patent counsel to 3,500+ companies, so a documented group page exists. Adjacent IP litigation and PTAB work supports defending a patent position. missing for 10: named individual patent practitioners, explicit description of application drafting/filing and portfolio-strategy services, independent corroboration.
